prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Ruthenium (Ru) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a bus shelter on a quiet street, a narrow bench, a glass side panel and the road beyond
Time of day: night under neon and signage light, coloured reflections.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a canvas workshop apron over a fitted ribbed mini dress, sleeves pushed up — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a gold fountain-pen nib with a tiny hard silver-white bead fused to its tip up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — ruthenium: a hard, brittle silver-white metal of the platinum family, the last of its six sisters to be found, isolated in 1844 at Kazan University from the stubborn residue of Ural platinum ore and named for Ruthenia, the old Latin name of Russia; a little of it makes platinum harder, and with osmium and iridium it forms the tiny hard bead at the tip of a fountain-pen nib that lasts decades of writing; its catalysts swap partners between molecules and join them anew, and its wine-red dyes colour glass that turns sunlight into electricity — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original PNG retained; only WebP committed.

acceptance: User selected 1,1,4; approved commits and normal main publication; retain completed images without regeneration.

observations: 1024x1536 vertical output; one principal adult woman; painterly anime rendering.
The selected reference face, silver-white/wine-tip hair and skin tone are recognizable.
No extra or detached arms observed; visible hands attach to their forearms.
Background carries reference glass architecture rather than a clearly legible bus shelter.
Lower limbs or the far hand are outside the planned crop; unseen finger counts are not asserted.
qa.cause: Generated output deviates from the recorded scene/framing/costume constraints; original is retained under user approval.
